outcome: Frequency of EBF at discharge, 2 weeks, 1 month, 4 months, and 6 months
cohort: 673 mother-newborn pairs from obstetrics and gynecology departments of two main hospitals in Zanjan.
finding: While EBF rates were high at discharge, they decreased over 6 months, with urban residence, lower maternal education, longer birth intervals, and lack of breastfeeding experience and planning being associated with non-EBF.
